He introduced the tube flap grafting method, corneal transplantation and preservation of grafts from cadaver eyes. The tomb of Vladimir Filatov. 2nd Christian Cemetery in Odessa.

The tombstone of Nadezhda Puchkovskaya. The Second Christian Cemetery in Odessa.

After Filatov's death in 1956, his apprentice Nadezhda Puchkovskaya led the Institute of Eye Diseases & Tissue Therapy in Odessa, which was renamed in honor of Filatov as The Filatov Institute of Eye Diseases & Tissue Therapy.
